## Summary

Describe the change and why it helps.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Explain any checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and related documentation/tests are updated.
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run test:python`, and `zola check` pass.
- [ ] UI or copy changes pass `npm run test:e2e` (or are not applicable).
- [ ] Accessibility, keyboard/touch, dark mode, and reduced motion are preserved.
- [ ] No private information, secrets, or generated files are included.
- [ ] Added assets have documented sources/licenses (or are not applicable).
